text:
Thank you, Dr. Wathan and Dr. Pim.
I had a serious problem with my teeth. I went to another leading hospital in the country and they recommended new dental implants, which cost hundreds of thousands of baht. I also had receding gums.

Dr. Wathan solved the problem by using braces, which eliminated the need for dental implants. The gaps between my teeth were reduced, which reduced the chance of food getting stuck. My teeth are perfectly straight, and it took less than a year to straighten them. My bite has improved, and so much more.

The doctors gave me excellent advice. I'm so lucky to have met Dr. Wathan and Dr. Pim. They treat every patient to the best of their ability. I'm very impressed.
